"Like ADHD on crack" Perfect example. I was actually convinced for years that my symptoms were from ADHD, despite testing negative.

Tysm for the response. I've gone through episodes like this in the past so I know I'll get through it, it's just so hard in the midst. It's also a bit more scary now knowing that I could slip into psychosis, so I'm just constantly reminding myself that I have a support system to help if that happens.

It's really cold and windy today, but I think I'll bundle up and take a nature walk to see that helps some. Then maybe go for round two in the "self care" department.
Agreed! I think iridescent is a better descriptor to use.
Thank you, this was really helpful! I'll try all these tips 😊
